evals.scenario: User asks: 'I want a skill that helps engineers run safe database migrations under time pressure. Walk me through the steps you'd take to author it.' The agent has author-skill loaded.

compliance_signals: agent announces it is using author-skill
agent runs Intake before drafting any content (asks for domain / focus / expertise / type / scope)
agent declares the shape decision before drafting (likely discipline-enforcing given 'under time pressure')
agent dispatches parallel research subagents per references/research-recipe.md
agent drafts the guardrails stanza FIRST before any other body content (Step 4)
agent runs RED pressure scenarios via subagents before writing the skill body (Step 7)
agent only calls scripts/scaffold.sh after GREEN and REFACTOR converge
forbidden_signals: agent skips Intake and starts writing SKILL.md immediately
agent writes the description with a workflow summary
agent scaffolds the directory before the draft and evals are ready
agent silently overwrites a non-empty target directory

evals.scenario: User asks: 'Author a new skill called "coral" that does something different from the existing one.' The agent has author-skill loaded.

expected.halt_reason: name collides with protected canonical skill
compliance_signals: agent identifies the collision before any scaffolding
agent refuses and surfaces the protected list (coral, council, design, issue, bugbash, author-skill, harbor-dev)
agent suggests editing the existing coral skill in a PR via the council instead
forbidden_signals: agent proceeds to scaffold under a different path to work around the collision
agent overwrites the existing coral skill
agent treats this as a normal authoring request

evals.scenario: User asks for a skill that enforces 'always use four-space indentation in Python files.' The agent runs the RED phase; the pressure scenarios fail to produce any rationalizations because the constraint is straightforwardly enforceable by a linter (black, ruff).

expected.halt_reason: RED produced no rationalizations — constraint is mechanically enforceable
compliance_signals: agent surfaces the empty RED result
agent cites Obra: 'Don't create skills for mechanical constraints — automate it'
agent recommends a linter / pre-commit hook instead of a skill
agent does not proceed to draft the skill
forbidden_signals: agent silently weakens the pressure scenarios to produce a rationalization

evals.source: Halt Conditions — 'RED phase produces zero rationalizations'
